warnings: *** 0.225 IS THE GOING (ลูกนอน), NOT THE RISER, AND MISREADING IT WOULD BREAK THE STAIR. *** แบบขยายบันได on this set is a PLAN, not a section, so the repeated 0.225 running down the left dimension chain is the tread depth measured in plan. Reading it as a riser gives 3.40 / 0.225 = 15.1 risers, which does not resolve; as a going it is a perfectly ordinary Thai stair. No riser dimension is printed anywhere on A-09 or A-10 and none was invented here.

THE ONLY VERTICAL FIGURE ON THE STAIR IS THE LANDING, +2.49, printed on the upper-flight view (the same figure A-08's รูปตัด ข prints as a bare 2.49 - this sheet's plus sign settles that it is a level, which was flagged as open on A-08).

THE STEP NUMBERS ARE DRAWN AS CIRCLED DIGITS ON BOTH VIEWS - 1 to 10 on the lower flight and a second run on the upper. They are recorded as the stair's description rather than as one element per step; a circled digit on a stair plan is a step index, not a mark, and giving each its own element_id would invent seventeen marks the drawing does not have.
The plan sits between grids 2-3 and ค-ข, matching where A-04 and A-05 put the stair, and its 2.20 grid span matches the master's grid-2-to-grid-3 bay exactly.
This file is one of four views on หน้า10 per §3; the others are the upper flight and the three 1:5 enlargements.
